name: Electrician Apprenticeship (NCAEC, ApprenticeshipNC #29076)
sourceWorkbook: RCCC catalog 2026–27 (program 35130 and course pages), Self-Service course schedule Fall 2026 – Summer 2027, 2026–27 academic calendar, NCAEC apprenticeship handbook — compiled 2026-10-20
note: The NC Association of Electrical Contractors' four-year registered apprenticeship, hosted by RCCC Corporate & Continuing Education as four non-credit levels (CEUs, taught from the Mike Holt lesson plan): apprentices work full-time for a sponsoring contractor and attend one 3-hour class a week for 28 weeks a year (September – April). 336 classroom hours plus OSHA 10, 230 documented competency hours and 8,000 on-the-job hours over four years; the US DOL / NCCCS journeyworker certificate on completion. Cohorts enrol through NCAEC and RCCC Continuing Education, not open registration: 17 apprentices a year (the owner's figure, 2026-10-20); the night, start date and room for the current cohort are not published. On-the-job hours are recorded on each level, not scheduled. The levels map roughly onto the AAS core (I ≈ ELC 112/126/118, II ≈ 113/115, III ≈ 117/128, IV ≈ 119) but there is no published articulation.
weeklyHoursNote: Term hours per student are the catalog's weekly contact hours × 16 (the 16-week basis), whatever the term's length: the sessions carry them, the posted days, times and rooms place them. Hours and credits are the catalog's; sessions are the college's day sections; clinical hours are zero in every course.

courses.title: NCAEC Electrical I
courses.requisites: Registered with a sponsoring NCAEC contractor
courses.description: Year 1 of the NC Association of Electrical Contractors apprenticeship: OSHA construction safety, electrical theory and the basics of electrical systems, the digital multimeter, introduction to the NEC. 84 classroom hours (plus the 10-hour OSHA 10 online) in one 3-hour class a week for 28 weeks; 50 documented on-the-job competency hours and full-time work for the sponsoring contractor (about 2,000 hours a year).
